subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Alice — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

- Elara's goal: embed Redwood inference for clinical-notes summarization and triage; must be HIPAA-compliant.
- Primary constraint: PHI flow and auditability; security team indicated they require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a signed BAA.
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated (reserved GPU + VPC peering), Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem).

Tradeoffs we discussed: 
- Hosted API: lowest time-to-value, Redwood isolates keys and provides encryption, but customers often prefer Dedicated/Private when PHI and strict control required.
- Dedicated + VPC: gives you network isolation, predictable throughput, and we can maintain SOC2 controls + limited access.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full control and ideal for strict audit requirements — longer procurement and infra setup.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Can you confirm whether Elara requires Private/on-prem OR if Dedicated with VPC peering + BAA would be sufficient?
2) If SOC2 Type II and a BAA are the asks, I can share our redacted SOC2 report and a BAA template for legal review.
3) If you want, we can schedule a short technical call with your security team this week (30 min) to go over logging, key management, and audit artifacts.

Attaching: Redwood SOC2 Type II summary (redacted) for reference.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf]

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the recap. Confirming from our side:

- Elara will be putting PHI into the pipeline, so we do need a BAA in place before any production data flows.
- Our security policy prefers Dedicated with customer VPC peering, but depending on vendor controls we may escalate to Private (VPC-only deployment or on-prem).
- Required artifacts for procurement: SOC 2 Type II report (latest), encryption at-rest/in-transit details, penetration test summary, and evidence of access controls/audit logs.

Can you also confirm your retention and logging defaults and whether we can export audit logs to our SIEM? Our auditors will want a timeline for when artifacts can be shared.

If you can send the SOC2 PDF and a BAA draft, I will loop in procurement and our legal. Also please propose 2 slots for a 30-min security call this week.

Best,
Alice

Hi Alice — looping in a couple quick clarifications from product and compliance: 

1) Artifacts we can provide immediately (redacted where appropriate):
   - SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — we can share an executive summary within 24h and full report under NDA/secure link.
   - Penetration test executive summary and remediation notes.
   - Encryption details: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit, customer-managed KMS available for Dedicated/Private.
   - Audit logs: per-request token-level latency and request metadata; logs can be exported via secure delivery or pushed to your SIEM for Dedicated and Private deployments.

2) Deployment guidance: 
   - If timeline is < 4 weeks to production, Dedicated + VPC peering with BAA is usually the sweet spot.
   - Private on-prem is supported but typically a 2–3 month engagement (procurement, infra, air-gapped options).

3) BAA process: we have a standard BAA template; legal can review in parallel while your team evaluates the SOC2 materials.

Proposed security-call slots (PST): Thu 07 Oct 2026 10:00–10:30 or Thu 07 Oct 2026 15:00–15:30. Let us know which works.

To answer Ben's questions up-front: 
- Customer-managed KMS: supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; we can integrate with your AWS KMS/HSM or provide bring-your-own-key in the dedicated cluster.
- Audit log export: we support configurable retention and can push a 90-day rolling export to your SIEM for Dedicated or Private. For Hosted API we provide logs but exporting to external SIEM requires a different connector and extra controls.

I've attached the SOC2 executive summary and a BAA draft for your legal/procurement teams to start reviewing. If procurement wants the BAA routed to contracts@elarahealth.com, we'll have legal send the DocuSign link and track it under the deal (ELR-2026-0921).
